title: FileCreateCompleted
description: Result: a file was newly created under the File Storage Adapter's watch_dir (Design.md Decision #19). Published two ways: (1) in reply to a FileWriteRequested whose path didn't already exist — eventDetails.correlationId is set to that request's; (2) with no preceding command at all, when the adapter's external-creation watch (Design.md §12 Step C5) notices a file appear from an outside process — eventDetails.correlationId is absent in that case.

path.description: File path, relative to watch_dir, that was created.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the file's content in bytes, as written.

occurredAt.description: UTC timestamp (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601) the creation completed.
